Catton Grove — Norwich, United Kingdom

Average day Average night

In detail

Norfolk Constabulary recorded 327 crimes inside this ward's official boundary over the 3 months to July 2026 — an average of 9.8 per 1,000 residents a month, the 5th highest rate of Norwich's 13 wards. The daytime score here is driven by shoplifting (13), vehicle crime (3), drugs (2); the evening/night score by violent crime (41), anti social behaviour (23), public order (6). Those two scores are split by offence type, not by clock time — the police feed records no time of day, so day and night here mean the kinds of crime typical of each, not counts of incidents observed then. Rated against the average of the city's own wards, never against another city.

Frequently asked questions

Is Catton Grove safe?

Wandroz currently rates Catton Grove in Norwich as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Norwich, both by day and after dark. This rating is derived from Norfolk Constabulary street-level crime records published at data.police.uk — an official statistic, not an assessment. High-footfall tourist, transit or shopping areas can read higher on this kind of measure without that meaning elevated risk per visit, since these statistics are normalised against registered residents rather than footfall — see the note on this page and the methodology page for the full caveats.

Is Catton Grove safe at night?

At night, Catton Grove is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Norwich. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.

Is Catton Grove a good area to stay in as a tourist?

Catton Grove's day rating (roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Norwich) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Note that the Booking.com link on this page searches Norwich, not Catton Grove specifically: Booking does not list this neighbourhood as a destination of its own, so check each property's address against the map above.
